text:
sara: Quick question — I'm prototyping a 'preview' flow for pluggable routing + quota changes in the console. Idea: a toggle that runs a dry-run of route decisions and shows estimated token/sec and cohort impact before you push. Anyone think this is a bad idea?
lee: +1. We need to surface sample rate and the exact telemetry keys so SRE can avoid surprises.
mike: How do you want to compute estimated token/sec? Historical per-route p95 * expected traffic delta? That could be noisy.
ari: We should make the preview a first-class API: a /route/preview that accepts config_delta + sample_pct and returns decision logs and estimates. Make it opt-in via a runtime flag.
ops-bot: deploybot: deploy 1686543300 started for routing-probe-service (can track at https://deploys.rwd.internal/1686543300) :rocket:
sara: Sketch of the API I had in mind:
```json
POST /v1/route/preview
{
  "route_id": "pricing-model-v2",
  "config_delta": { /* same shape as runtime config */ },
  "sample_pct": 3,
  "warmup": false
}

Response:
{
  "decision": "route-variant-a",
  "explanation": "prefix-match + weight 20/80",
  "est_qps_delta": 42,
  "est_tokens_per_sec": 1200
}
```
We intentionally keep returned fields minimal to avoid PII.
lee: Suggest metric names so we can wire dashboards and alerts: routing.preview.sampled.requests, routing.preview.estimate.qps_delta, routing.preview.estimate.tokens_per_sec, routing.preview.error_ratio. Also tag all preview telemetry with preview=true and write to a preview dataset so prod dashboards aren't polluted.
mike: Important: preview must never mutate quota buckets. Add dry_run=true in the routing path so quota service is not called when preview.
ari: Edge-case: cache-warming will make estimates off for cold paths. Add warmup param or simulate cold-cache by clearing KV hits for the sample (or approximate). Also add a note in the console: 'estimates assume current cache state — results may differ on first N requests'.
sara: UX notes: console shows a side-by-side diff of affected cohorts, a histogram of latency and token delta, sample_pct control, and a 'create rollout' button that can push to the existing rollout API with prefilled cohorts.
mike: Can we reuse /v1/config/rollout with preview=true instead of a new endpoint? Less surface area if rollout API accepts preview param.
lee: Fine either way but telemetry must be separate. We should write: if preview=true then tag metrics and route them to preview dataset. Also require an approval step when sample_pct > 10% or est_qps_delta > 20%.
ari: +1 on approval. Also propose auto-rollback if routing.preview.error_ratio > 0.15 within first hour of rollout (for live rollouts). For preview, fail fast if estimate error > threshold.
sara: Action items: mike — draft API/Swagger + sample payloads; lee — define metric names + preview dataset + dashboard mock; ari — define gating/approval rules and rollback triggers; I'll mock the console UI and wire the 'push rollout' flow. Please post PR/links in this thread.
mike: Will sketch swagger and a minimal mock server by EOD.
lee: Adding metric names to tracking doc now (https://metrics.rwd.internal/doc/preview-metrics).
sara: Also thinking about RBAC: only users with config.rollout:create should be able to run previews that push to rollout. Preview-only should be allowed to anyone with config.view.
ari: Good call. Another edge: if preview sample_pct spans multiple tenants, the sample must be deterministic per tenant to avoid double-sampling. Use a hash-based sampling key.
sara: Good point — add deterministic sampling to the API contract.
lee: Recommendation: preview telemetry ingestion should be turned off by default in prod accounts. Opt-in per-org.
sara: Agreed. Also we should require an RFC so we have a record of metrics and rollback rules. I'll file one tonight.
ops-bot: deploybot: deploy 1686544300 routing-probe-service SUCCESS :white_check_mark:
sara: RFC posted: https://rwd.internal/rfc/456-preview-routing-probe — please comment (I've attached console mocks and API examples). Thanks all!
